comments.author: @MisterAAB1
comments.text: Other than the mishaps showing images of unrelated places of Hawaii and the Caribbean in the video, the majority of the short film was very nice. I personally have been to or stayed in Tijuana, Rosarito, Ensenada, San Felipe, and Cabo San Lucas. LaPaz, Bahia Concepcion, Todos Santos, and Loreto are all on my list of where to go next. Nice video.
